title: Far-pair offset collimation with collective spectral sources

claims.statement: For every integer N >= 2 and every s modulo N, the collective-spectral far-pair algorithm in proof.md, with n=ceil(log2 N), its public integer schedule and two deterministic budgets, and its finite-length fallback, recovers the entire s with unconditional probability greater than 0.98 under the collective spectral source model in proof.md, including independent ideal copies. The same configuration jointly has branchwise charged sequential work O(2^((9/8) sqrt(n log2 n) + (7/8) sqrt(n) + sqrt(n)*(log2 n)^(-1/4))), with exact growth index 1/2.

structured.error_model: The collective spectral source described in proof.md uses consecutive blocks of 2*K standard raw (n+1)-qubit copies, for public K. At block start the supplier chooses a channel from private memory to the full block and updated memory. For every input density operator, the raw marginal is supported in V_s^(tensor 2K), where V_s is spanned by the standard phase-row and position Fourier eigenvector products in proof.md. In the virtual exact position-label measurement, for each nonzero cyclic character and every positive-probability prefix through the first label of a pair, the next (second) label has conditional Fourier coefficient of magnitude at most 1-2^(-10). No condition is imposed on first labels. The provider may then apply any isometry sum_h Pi_h tensor V_h, with Pi_h the projector on total block branch weight h and V_h an isometry on private memory; this fixes all position registers. Block preparations can be entangled with private memory and earlier blocks. The provider chooses channels and isometries using earlier classical observations and private memory, and emits the prepared block in order without changing the chosen action within that block. It has no access to delivered registers or future private solver randomness. No labels or flags are given. Up to floor(epsilon(n) Q) of the actual acquired copies may be affected, including all Q for epsilon(n)=1. Independent ideal copies are included by the uniform product preparation and identical memory isometries. The guarantee is for this specified model.
